name: MCP Playwright
tagline: Browser automation via MCP — take screenshots, scrape pages, generate test code, and execute JavaScript in a real browser.
description: Playwright MCP Server provides browser automation capabilities for LLMs. Interact with web pages, take screenshots, generate test code, web scrape, and execute JavaScript in a real browser environment. Supports 143 real device presets (iPhone, iPad, Pixel, Galaxy, Desktop). Works with Claude Desktop, Cline, Cursor IDE, VS Code, and any MCP client. Automatic browser installation, HTTP and stdio modes.
author: executeautomation
